import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    L=np.log(eps)
    return (params[0] + params[1]*T + params[2]*T**2 + params[3]*T**2.5
            + params[4]/eps + params[5]*T/eps + params[6]*T**2/eps
            + params[7]*L + params[8]*T*L + params[9]*T**2*L)
